title: Cloud Test Machine power
summary: Cloud Test Machines start by instance id under their host lease and wait for SSH on the unchanged registered MagicDNS name. They stay running after lease release until an operator stops them. All hosts, Macs included, manually install Tailscale, join the operator tailnet and register their MagicDNS name. Windows joins unattended on Windows only. EC2 retains auto-assigned public IPv4 only while running, without Elastic IPs. Azure creates and attaches a Standard public IP before start. During a manual shutdown the operator deallocates the VM, detaches the public IP from the NIC and deletes it. The NIC supplies outbound on the private subnet; NSG admits key-only OpenSSH from anywhere, with desktops forwarded. Power never reads or writes the registered host. HostKeyAlias remains the cloud instance id. Host-rebind is retired with a per-surface client floor and function_version_skew. Target-change refusal and proven settings remain. Rollout joins first, deploys second, registers MagicDNS third, deletes the permanent Azure IP last. The operator approved manual setup; tailnet policy, tags, key machinery and IaC are outside this item. Rebuild removes the old device before joining again to avoid a name suffix, and verifies/clears the SSH pin; reset never changes Tailscale. Browser authorization, desktop-access and yoke test-machine exec acquire a host lease or borrow the caller's own, power on before their host work, and release only their own lease after cleanup; exec under a foreign lease refuses test_machine_leased without powering on. Authorized steering assistance preserves the foreign lease.
